parameters.jsCode: const normalize=value=>String(value||'').trim().toLowerCase().normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').replace(/^https?:\/\//,'').replace(/^www\./,'').split('/')[0]; const keyFor=lead=>{const domain=normalize(lead.domain); if(domain) return `d:${domain}`; const company=normalize(lead.company_name||lead.company||''); const location=normalize(lead.location||''); if(company) return `c:${company}:${location}`; const email=normalize(lead.contact_email||''); if(email) return `e:${email}`; return null;}; const all=$input.all().flatMap(i=>Array.isArray(i.json)?i.json:[i.json]).filter(l=>l&&l.id&&l.status!=='suppressed'); const unique=new Map(); for(const lead of all){const key=keyFor(lead); if(!key) continue; const current=unique.get(key); const has=Boolean(lead.contact_whatsapp||lead.contact_email||lead.contact_phone); const currentHas=current&&Boolean(current.contact_whatsapp||current.contact_email||current.contact_phone); const score=Number(lead.lead_score||lead.score||0); const currentScore=Number(current?.lead_score||current?.score||0); const pain=Number(lead.pain_score||0); const currentPain=Number(current?.pain_score||0); if(!current||(has&&!currentHas)||(has===currentHas&&(score>currentScore||(score===currentScore&&pain>currentPain)))) unique.set(key,lead);} const leads=[...unique.values()]; leads.sort((a,b)=>Number(Boolean(b.contact_whatsapp||b.contact_email||b.contact_phone))-Number(Boolean(a.contact_whatsapp||a.contact_email||a.contact_phone))||(Number(b.lead_score||b.score||0)-Number(a.lead_score||a.score||0))||(Number(b.pain_score||0)-Number(a.pain_score||0))); return leads.slice(0,100).map((lead,index)=>({json:{priority:index+1,...lead,opportunity_type:lead.crm&&lead.pain_score>=45?'otimização de processos e CRM':lead.crm?'otimização de CRM':lead.pain_score>=45?'implantação de CRM e melhoria do atendimento':'automação comercial'}}));
